rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA) / Known or Suspected Pulmonary Embolism (PE) (1–5)

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute pulmonary embolism with high pre-test probability (Wells/Geneva score) or positive D-dimer

required_documentation: Clinical evaluation notes documenting Wells score, oxygen saturation, tachycardia, or quantitative D-dimer assay
rules.review_notes: Emergency and outpatient pulmonary embolism protocol CTA.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA) / THORACIC AORTIC DISEASE

criteria.description: Suspected acute thoracic aortic syndrome (aortic dissection, intramural hematoma, penetrating atherosclerotic ulcer) or evaluation of thoracic aortic aneurysm

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing acute chest/back tearing pain, widened mediastinum on X-ray, or known aneurysm surveillance
rules.review_notes: Chest CTA is the reference standard for acute thoracic aortic syndrome.
